title: Could you explain how shared living areas are maintained and what guests are responsible for keeping clean?

segments.text: We want to ensure everyone has a comfortable, organized, and peaceful stay. Please keep the following guidelines in mind regarding accommodation and facility care: ​Shared Accommodation: There are no separate private rooms or quarters. Everyone will sleep together in the main halls or in specific arrangements organized by the Ashaeiynn team. Rest assured, there is plenty of space to comfortably accommodate everyone! ​Sleeping on the Ground: In our tradition, only the Guru sits on a throne (Guru Gaddi), while all devotees sleep on the ground to foster humility and devotion. Bed frames are not provided; mattresses, bedsheets, pillows, and light blankets will be supplied. You are also welcome to bring your own bedding. ​Daily Routine & Daytime Rules: ​No Daytime Bedding Setup: Bedding cannot be set up or left out during the day. You may only spread out your bedding at night when you are ready to sleep. ​Resting Areas: If you need to rest during the day, you may lie down in the designated resting/tapa room, but sleeping essentials cannot be unpacked there. ​Morning Tidy-Up: Upon waking, everyone is required to pack up their own bedding and return mattresses, pillows, and sheets to their proper places. Please do not leave them for others or volunteers to clean up. ​Shared Responsibility for Cleanliness: Keeping Ashaeiynn clean is a collective responsibility, not just the job of volunteers. Since all living areas are shared, everyone’s cooperation in maintaining hygiene and order is warmly encouraged and appreciated. ​Luggage Room & Personal Belongings: ​A dedicated luggage room is available to store your bags. To accommodate hundreds of guests smoothly, please keep the area tidy, organize your items, and avoid leaving clothes on top of bags or cluttering the space. ​Keep Belongings Secured: You are responsible for setting up your own sleeping area and managing your own items. Please keep all personal belongings zipped inside your luggage bags. While the entire venue is under CCTV surveillance, the management is not responsible for missing items. ​Hall & Restroom Facilities: The main halls are fully air-conditioned and spacious. There are two separate sets of dedicated bathrooms for men and women. ​Laundry & Rain Care: A washing machine is available, and clothes can be dried on the roof. As it will be the rainy season, please bring extra poly bags to store wet clothes. ​Queries & Support: Volunteers are on hand to assist and manage spaces, but if you have any questions or need help finding bedding provisions, please feel free to ask them.
